store_copy: scratchpad sports/starter/data (Starter agent's real-feed copy): canonical.db 222 MB, 80,470 offers, 1,331 events, 14,576 forecasts, 2,022 settlements; model/forecasts.db 59 MB
store_copy_grown: same + 200,000 synthetic forecasts of played events (canonical.db 538 MB, forecasts.db 895 MB)

runs.job: fwd run with NBA refresh (real now 2026-10-24 ~13:00Z, ESPN live)
learning.on_settled (base 236ab45: every forecast of 30 days, per-forecast settlement scan)

packaged_history_equivalence: every forecast of the run on the store copy came back 'unchanged': the input key (offer revision, feature-row hash data_version, artifact, output) of forecasts made from the packaged history equals that of the forecasts the model agent made from the training history.db - same features, same probabilities
cap: scheduler cap 340 MB (exclusive); service ~52 MB peak at 700 members -> worst admitted 392 MB by reservation, ~358 MB measured

disk.bytes_per_forecast: ~5.1 KB: model/forecasts.db 59,437,056 B / 14,576 inputs rows = 4.08 KB + canonical forecast row ~1.0 KB (payload 639 B avg + ids/columns/indexes) + forecast_keys ~0.1 KB
disk.changed_eligible_target_offers_per_30_mi: 121 / 339 / 1,183 in the three steady windows of the copy (night, 2026-10-23 23:00 - 03:00Z); board 9.4k-10.9k open offers of not-started events
disk.forecasts_per_changed_offer: ~0.24 (snapshot views 2,623 / board 10,886 - many offers have no ESPN-team / nflverse mapping or no fresh quote)
disk.estimate_mb_per_day: 7-70 (central ~20) at the 30-min cadence: 5.8k-57k changes/day x 0.24 x 5.1 KB; the cadence collapses A->B->A churn inside 30 min (only the current revision at run time is forecast).
